blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Overcast skies and rain are forecast over parts of Visayas and Mindanao on Saturday due to the trough of a typhoon located outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR). According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) in its latest forecast, Typhoon Choi-Wan was located 2,430 kilometers (km) east of Northern Luzon. It is carrying wind speeds of 130 km per hour (kph) and gustiness of up to 160 kph.
